accepts.because: run a cycle NOW rather than at the next tick -- a cost alert or a DLQ spike is a reason not to wait for the clock

emits.because: the change this loop decided on, as an ordinary params update -- body `{system:{}, params:{...}}`, hop.target naming the cell it belongs to. The parent draws one edge per cell the loop may reach, so what is in range is a fact about the seed

a watched symptom crossed zero and no model was asked about it -- the metric, the goal that watched for it, the count and the window it was counted over. This is the whole of what an `observe` goal does when it sees something, and it is deliberately not a decision: a control loop that reacts to a symptom without a hypothesis is a random walk with receipts. A parent that draws no edge for it gets the receipt and no alert, which is a legitimate way to run it.
a step of the cycle could not complete; which step it was is this hive business, that it failed is the caller business

description.purpose: Scope marker of the argus hive: the colony's control loop and its watcher. Charter -> measure -> judge (and simulate) -> params update to the named cell -> health check -> measure the effect -> keep or revert -> receipt. EVERY tick leaves a receipt, the tick that found nothing enabled and the cycle that died at a store reject included, so the table is a chain rather than a list of the moments something was decided. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS: `params.ports` is empty, so no edge reaches a cell in here; a caller names the hive and a lane on `hop.route`.
description.use_when: Once per colony, under /colony's sibling level. The charter ships every goal DISABLED, so a freshly grown argus changes nothing until somebody turns a row on -- it does still tick, and every one of those ticks is receipted as `idle`, because a loop whose clock has stopped and a loop with an empty charter must not write the same nothing.
description.not_in_scope: No operator lane -- a change leaves as an ordinary message and only reaches a cell a human wired an edge to. No mutation at all, in fact: nothing in here authors a diff, so the loop cannot add, remove or rewire a cell. No topology change either: radius v1 is model choice plus numeric params, and a topology proposal is recorded for a human rather than executed. And no second bookkeeping: what it measures, it reads out of the substrate's own ledger, read-only.
description.contract_in: One lane, at the hive path. in_cycle -- run a cycle now instead of waiting for the clock. Which cell starts it is this hive's business.
description.contract_out: Three lanes, out of the hive path. mutate -- the decided change as an ordinary params update, hop.target naming the cell it is for; a parent wires one edge per cell the loop may reach, and a parent that wires none gets an argus that measures and receipts and changes nothing. alert -- a watched symptom crossed zero, deterministically and without a model: the metric, its count and the window. error -- a step of the cycle could not complete.
